questions.stem:
a) Define the term “Collective Agreement” in Nigerian Labour Law. 
b) Explain the mechanisms for the enforcement of collective agreement in Nigeria.

a) Define Trade Union under the Trade Unions Act and discuss the essential features in the definition. 
b) Discuss the basic requirements for the registration of a Trade Union.

a) Discuss the meaning of trade dispute under the Trade Disputes Act. 
b) Explain the various methods introduced by the law for the management of labour disputes under the Trade Disputes Act.

a) Explain the meaning of a factory under Section 87 of the Factories Act. 
b) Discuss at least four (4) provisions for the welfare of employees at work under Part IV of the Factories Act.
Discuss the concept of strike under the Trade Disputes Act and explain the different types of strike under the Act.

Dissatisfied with the negligent treatment and denials of benefits at their workplace, Mohammed, Adeyinka, Ogbonna and Ekpe who are members of the Nigerian Air Force, have come together to form a trade union to be known as “The Air force Military Union”. They have approached you for legal advice. Advise them on the constitutionality or otherwise of their intention. Support your advice with statutory provisions or case law.
